definitions.explanation: A building or structure that has been recently constructed. Also used as a noun meaning 'new construction' or as a no-adjective meaning 'newly built.'

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}のマンションに{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I moved into a newly built apartment building.

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}{一戸建|いっこだ}てを{購入|こうにゅう}した。
examples.english: I purchased a newly built detached house.

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}の{匂|にお}いがまだする。
examples.english: It still smells like new construction.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{新|しん} (new) + {築|ちく} (construction, building)

VERB FORM:
・{新築|しんちく}する (to newly construct)

CONTRAST:
・{新築|しんちく} (newly built) ↔ {中古|ちゅうこ} (used, pre-owned)
・{新築|しんちく} ↔ {築|ちく}〇{年|ねん} (〇 years old building)

RELATED TERMS:
・{増築|ぞうちく} (building extension)
・{改築|かいちく} (renovation, rebuilding)
・{建|た}て{替|か}え (rebuilding)
・{建築|けんちく} (architecture, construction)

REAL ESTATE VOCABULARY:
・{新築|しんちく}{物件|ぶっけん} (newly built property)
・{新築|しんちく}{分譲|ぶんじょう} (new for-sale housing)
・{新築|しんちく}マンション (new condominium building)
・{新築|しんちく}{戸建|こだ}て (new detached house)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{新築|しんちく}を{建|た}てる (to build new construction)
・{新築|しんちく}に{住|す}む (to live in a new building)
・{新築|しんちく}{祝|いわ}い (housewarming gift)
